description: This file defines a KafkaTemplate class implementing the IQueue interface, managing Kafka producer and consumer setup, message batching, topic creation, and resource cleanup for a messaging system within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: KafkaTemplate
classes.description: A class that manages Kafka message production and consumption, including topic management, batching, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Kafka client, creates topics if needed, sets up consumer and producer, and starts message processing loop.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified response topic with given key, payload, and headers.

methods.name: pushMessageToSendLater
methods.description: Adds a message to the batch queue and triggers batch send if size exceeds maxBatchSize.

methods.name: sendMessagesAsBatch
methods.description: Sends accumulated batched messages to Kafka, with error handling and retry logic.

methods.name: parseTopicProperties
methods.description: Parses topic property string into configuration entries.

methods.name: createTopic
methods.description: Creates a Kafka topic with specified name and partition count.

methods.name: sendLoopWithLinger
methods.description: Sets up a delayed loop to send batched messages after a linger period.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down Kafka admin, consumer, and producer resources.

methods.name: disconnectProducer
methods.description: Disconnects the Kafka producer, ensuring batched messages are sent before shutdown.
